items.title: Troubleshooting Data Mismatches with tablediff on Amazon RDS for SQL Server
items.summary: Learn how to use the SQL Server tablediff utility to validate an Amazon RDS for SQL Server read replica against its primary after a replication lag event, detect and classify row-level data mismatches, and apply auditable T-SQL fix scripts on a promoted replica instance.
items.creator: Kanchan Bhattacharyya
